verdict.rationale: BugSnag's docs show errors are associated with releases. You can identify which release an error was introduced in and filter the dashboard by release (bugsnag-docs-4, bugsnag-docs-38). Release annotations on the timeline correlate versions with error-rate changes (bugsnag-docs-25), and the CLI creates builds to enrich releases (bugsnag-docs-12, bugsnag-docs-45). Stack traces link to the line of code on some platforms (bugsnag-docs-43). However, the pack contains nothing about attaching commit metadata to releases or flagging a suspect commit per issue. missing for 10: suspect-commit identification per issue, documented commit association for releases/builds, independent or hands-on corroboration of release-introduced tracking.
